description: I’m clear about the direction that I want to take. I no longer accept unnecessary challenges. Our internal worlds belong to us and requires wisdom to support our nervous systems. 🪴#fyp #motivation #LifeByDesign #reinventingmyself
transcript: I no longer tolerate things that I don't want to because exploration and experiences has taught me to clearly see where I land. Evolution has taught me that I'm multidimensional, I am flexible, and wherever I land during this journey, I will do well. It allows me the space to see myself for who I truly am in every situation. I have a clear understanding of where I belong and where I flourish the best.
